subject: [PATCH v3 04/11] scsi: mpt3sas: Fix pcie_device leak in _scsih_ublock_io_device_wait()

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch fixes a memory leak in the mpt3sas driver by properly releasing a PCIe device reference after each use, preventing the driver from leaking references and being unable to free the PCIe device.
